notes.title: Update Notice V 1.0.2
notes.content:
Hi,

For reasons beyond our control previous content is not possible to be added to the novel.

We're very sorry for any inconvenience this may cause you. 

- Compensation -
Two additional chapters following the main story will be added as compensation for all the trouble. One on the next patch this month, and the final one through September.

Thank you.
